normative_claims.text: The S4-R5 change set is a continuation whose D1/D2 and ClaimCeiling repairs must not be re-implemented if they are already on the merged main; the round verifies them and closes only what is still open.
A new tag, a merge to main and a release publication are separate human acts; no agent may perform them, and the served bytes may never be replaced in place.
The private plugin ZIP is skills-only, exactly the existing eight skills, with no MCP, Apps, Actions or Hooks, and the public directory route stays out of scope.
Every PASS needs a frozen subject identity, raw output, and a producer that is not the checker; a maker's test pass is not a checker verdict.
The credential is read only through a scoped local flow, must never be printed or persisted, and only the one approved branch of the one repository may be written.

intent.goal: Re-verify the S4-R5 change set delta-only on its LIVE subject, repair the one defect that is still real (the install route and the release identity record), keep the repair inside documentation/metadata plus a derived guard, and return a machine-readable evidence pack for external acceptance.
intent.user_expected_outcome: A reader following the front page reaches the bytes the release actually serves; the repository records every served identity and can re-derive it.
intent.user_expected_experience: The owner sees one scoped pull request with the round's evidence beside it, and no claim raised above what was measured.
explicit_constraints: delta-only: do not redo D1/D2/TYPE5 if already on main
no product code, no ninth skill, no MCP/Apps/Hooks, no second control plane
no tag, no release, no merge to main, no in-place asset replacement
credential never printed, never in argv/env/logs, scoped to one repository and one branch
every claim carries a locator and raw output
non_goals: re-cutting a wheel or plugin ZIP
authorized_mutations: one derived guard test and one openspec change record
